body.text: This document describes the proposal for engagement to be executed by and between SHELLCODE Private Limited and Acme Manufacturing Private Limited, effective from {{effective_date}} and ending {{expiration_date}}.
ShellKode is a cloud-native company with a global presence, delivering services from multiple strategic locations worldwide.
Acme Manufacturing is a leading industrial producer seeking to modernize its data platform on AWS.
The objective of this phase is to set up the foundational AWS data lake infrastructure.

items.text: Provision S3-based data lake with tiered storage

items: Configure AWS Glue Data Catalog and crawlers
Set up Amazon Athena for ad-hoc querying

rows: Provision S3 data lake and Glue catalog
Share source system access and credentials
